response.sql: SELECT f.orderslink, o.mktnote, AVG(f.rebrate) as avg_rebrate, SUM(f.rebtotal) as total_rebate FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote ORDER BY total_rebate IS NULL, total_rebate DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: NULL values in rebrate and rebtotal are ignored when calculating AVG and SUM, respectively—standard SQL aggregation behavior where NULLs do not participate in averages or sums.
